findings.title: Cancellations can wait until after the reminder has been sent
findings.body: Cancelled email reminders are only submitted to SendGrid when this 15-minute cron next runs and the reminder is within the next hour. For example, if a reminder is due in five minutes and the booking is cancelled immediately after a cron run, no cancellation request is made for up to 15 minutes, so SendGrid can deliver the reminder at its scheduled time. This leaves the primary cancelled-booking case unfixed for reminders cancelled shortly before they are due; cancellation needs to be performed promptly enough to beat the send time (or the scheduling job needs to run with a sufficiently tight guarantee).

findings.title: Expired cancelled reminders are deleted without cancelling their SendGrid send
findings.body: The expired-reminder cleanup runs before the new cancellation loop and deletes every email reminder whose scheduledDate is at or before now, including rows marked cancelled. If the cron is late or SendGrid has not yet processed a send scheduled for that timestamp, the local record is removed and the later cancellation pass can no longer submit the required SendGrid cancellation. The scheduled email can consequently still be delivered, and there is no remaining row to retry cancellation. Cancelled reminders should be handled/cancelled before generic expiry cleanup, and failed cancellations should remain retryable.
